description: This file defines a C# class 'StatelessWorkerStreamConsumerGrain' which is a stateless worker grain in Orleans. It handles stream consumption with methods for subscribing to streams and handling stream events.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerStreamConsumerGrain
classes.description: A stateless worker grain in Orleans for consuming streams, with a method to subscribe to streams and handle stream events.

methods.name: OnCompletedAsync
methods.description: Handles stream completion event, currently a no-op.

methods.name: OnErrorAsync
methods.description: Handles stream error event, currently a no-op.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Handles incoming stream items, currently a no-op.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Subscribes the grain to a specified stream provider and stream ID.
